# International Journal of Technology

> An open-access, peer-reviewed engineering journal published by the University of Indonesia featuring research across multiple engineering disciplines.

IJTech is a leading international academic journal that publishes original research in engineering and technology. The journal maintains rigorous peer-review standards and provides free access to all published articles, promoting knowledge sharing in the global engineering community.

## Key Topics

- open-access publishing
- peer-review process
- academic journal
- engineering research
- technology research
- author guidelines
- submission process

- journal ethics

- University of Indonesia
- quantum technology
- fiber optics
- online-first articles
